name: Minced meat in a leaf
summary: Thái minced meat grilled in a leaf. Báo Sơn La, on 1 April 2022, names nhứa pỉnh with grilled chicken and pa pỉnh tộp. On 16 July 2026 the same paper minces pork with rau cải, scallion, garlic, chili, mắc khén, and pepper, wraps it in banana leaf, clamps it with two bamboo sticks, and grills it. A Chiềng Cơi kitchen on that date prints about 120,000–150,000 VND a plate. On 4 September 2020 the mince is beaten with egg and wrapped in banana leaf or dong leaf, then grilled or buried in hot ash. Both wraps stay.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 1 April 2022, 4 September 2020, and 16 July 2026.
howToEat: With sticky rice or plain rice, on the 16 July 2026 account. That account prints about 120,000–150,000 VND a plate at a Chiềng Cơi kitchen. A market price and an hour are Check on arrival.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi, on the 16 July 2026 price. The 2020 and 2022 accounts do not name a ward.
priceBand: Báo Sơn La, 16 July 2026, prints about 120,000–150,000 VND a plate at a Chiềng Cơi kitchen. A market price was not printed.
seoTitle: Nhua pinh in Son La — minced meat grilled in a leaf
seoDescription: Nhứa pỉnh in Sơn La. One Báo Sơn La account uses pork and banana leaf. Another beats the mince with egg and allows dong leaf. A Chiềng Cơi plate is about 120,000–150,000 VND.
